verse.verse_1: Read! In the name of your Lord, who created:
verse.verse_2: created man from a clot [of blood].
verse.verse_3: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One
verse.verse_5: taught man what he did not know.
verse.verse_8: truly, all will return to your Lord.
verse.verse_9: Have you seen one who prevents
verse.verse_11: Do you think he is rightly guided,
verse.verse_13: Do you see how he has denied the truth and turned away from it?
verse.verse_14: Does he not know that God observes all things?
verse.verse_15: Let him beware! If he does not desist, We will drag him by the forelock --
verse.verse_17: Then let him call his associates;
verse.verse_18: We shall summon the guards of Hell.
verse.verse_19: No indeed! Do not obey him, but prostrate yourself and come closer to God.
